item.title: China Open Source Daily — 2026-08-20
item.description: OpenAtom Foundation publishes its July 2026 partner-expansion roster — a monthly cadence now visible as the foundation's institutional-expansion instrument; the CCF Open Source Development Technology Committee holds its 2026 annual work meeting in Chongqing, shifting the institutional-architecture object of the CCF Open Source Committee from 'governance of the community' to 'organizational design of the committee itself'; the Mulan Open Source Community publishes the first batch of Youth Open Source Special Fund seed-project awardees, converting a previously announced fund into a concrete funding mechanism with named beneficiaries; BAAI's Zhongzhi team integrates CUDA Tile IR into FlagOS's multi-chip unified compiler FlagTree — the first institutional move that positions BAAI's open-computing platform (established in the August 15 briefing's OpenAtom industrial-software community documentation) as an AI-chip-compiler standard claim; Global Times (via PRNewswire, Yahoo Finance, August 2026) publishes 'China advances global AI governance in a comprehensive manner,' the first Global Times article to treat WAICO (formalized in the August 16 briefing) not as a diplomatic initiative but as a comprehensive AI-governance export vehicle — extending the 'standards-export' framing from a bilateral claim (August 16) into a comprehensive multi-vector claim.

item.title: China Open Source Daily — 2026-08-15
item.description: The Financial Times reports Moonshot AI has executed a governance shake-up ahead of its Hong Kong IPO, reportedly to win Beijing's approval for a mainland capital-market debut — the first documented case of a Chinese open-weight AI lab restructuring its corporate governance as an explicit prerequisite for regulatory clearance; DeepSeek's new peak-hour / off-peak API pricing (effective August 16) introduces a temporal-tier model that institutionalizes the cost-advantage logic as a real-time pricing regime rather than a one-time distribution decision; OpenAtom Foundation's newly launched 'Open Instrumentation & Control Systems Community' (开放原子仪控系统开源社区) at the Chongqing Industrial Software Conference designates Toowei Information / 开鸿智谷 as its first co-building unit, marking the foundation's transition from narrative-producing institution to sectoral-industrial-standards institution.

item.title: China Open Source Daily — 2026-08-10
item.description: China accelerates the OSSification of industrial infrastructure: the OpenAtom Foundation launches its Control Systems Open Source Community on the industrial-software conference stage; Anolis (OpenAnolis) donates itself to OpenAtom and rebrands as 'AI-native'; The Diplomat charts WAICO's institutional agenda in the West's absence; KAIYUANSHE publishes its 2026 board of directors.

item.title: China Open Source Daily — 2026-08-09
item.description: DeepSeek resumes its $8B funding round at a $74B valuation as Monolith — the same Chinese backer behind Moonshot AI — enters negotiations; TechNode reports DeepSeek plans significant API price increases; OpenAtom Foundation publishes the AIP Agent Interconnection Protocol on its domestic AtomGit platform, operationalizing China's first national standard for AI agent interconnection; Monolith announces a $500M new fund.

item.title: China Open Source Daily — 2026-07-29
item.description: Kimi K3 open-source model challenges closed-source AI dominance; OpenAtom 'Park Tour' Hong Kong Station launches openEuler's first overseas regional community.

item.title: China Open Source Daily — 2026-07-28
item.description: CCF ChinaOSC 2026 preview: Xenomai real-time OS for embodied intelligence; OpenAtom Deep Report finds AI open source entering 'ecosystem decisive' era; CR Power's RunDianHong IoT OS for power systems.

item.title: China Open Source Daily — 2026-07-27
item.description: 70+ local open source policies mark China's shift to 'value realization' phase; Zhejiang's 7-department open source system plan; Embodied AI's open source moment with 3M+ OpenLET dataset downloads; OpenAtom prepares AI Agent working group.
